snippet.title: KND Operation B.E.S.T. PC game play
snippet.description:
Long lost footage of the PC game from 2005 called Kids Next Door Operation B.E.S.T. This game was released as a seasonal semi-MMO along with episodes of the TV series. During the TV series the top scoring players were shown on TV along with their custom designed in-game avatar. This game played for only a short time as a promotion to get more kids to watch the TV show. Afterwards it was taken down forever. The game was developed by AWE Games, a company I co-founded in 1999.

Download the game for Windows from my website: http://www.lesbird.com
